Hiring: AI DevOps / MLOps Engineer | Kubernetes | Azure OpenAI | RAG | AKS




Hyderabad (Hybrid)




Insight Global is hiring for a leading Gaming Company!




Looking for an experienced AI DevOps / MLOps Engineer with strong expertise in Kubernetes, AKS, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD, CI/CD, and Azure Cloud to support production AI platforms and cloud-native applications.




Must Have:

5+ years in DevOps/MLOps/SRE/Platform Engineering
Strong Kubernetes (AKS preferred) experience
Docker, Helm, ArgoCD, GitFlow, CI/CD Pipelines
Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, RAG, LLM-based applications
Kubeflow, ML workflow orchestration, MLOps platforms
Monitoring & Observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, Datadog)
Production support, incident management, troubleshooting skills




Nice to Have:

AI Platform Engineering / LLMOps experience
Azure AI Services, GenAI workloads
Platform Reliability & SRE practices





Interested candidates can share their updated resume and contact details to nandiraju.balajiraju@insightglobal.com
